name: FAX CHAIN
description:
FAX CHAIN is a chain-letter fax machine game on Base. Send a fax, forward it to keep the chain alive, and mint your link as a tradeable collectible.

2,222 NFTs tiered by chain depth — from Dial Tone (1 hop) to Dead Letter (11+ hops). The deeper your chain, the rarer your mint. Forward without minting to push for a higher tier — but the thermal timer halves each time. Mint and the timer resets to72h for the next player. Push too far without minting and the line jams.

After sellout, a transparent on-chain prize draw selects 10 winners — one from each of 11 tiers — using a future block hash as the random seed. Anyone can recompute and verify the draw. 4.04 ETH prize pool.

5% royalty. Built on Base.
